text:
All three fixed:
1. A required flag no longer gets an implicit `False` default, so `--on/--off` with `required=True` now errors with "Missing option '--on'" when not given (`--on`/`--off` still work).
2. `click.echo` (and `err=True`), the progress bar and the pager now silently drop output when there is no stream (pythonw.exe / no console) instead of raising `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'write'`.
3. A flag with a `flag_value` and an `envvar` now uses the configured `flag_value` when the variable is set: `UPPER=whatever cmd` prints `upper`.
Full test suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed (unchanged from baseline).

All three fixed:
1. `click.argument(..., cls=...)` / `click.option(..., cls=...)` no longer consume `cls` from the shared attrs dict, so the same decorator can be applied to several commands and each gets your custom class.
2. `click.Path(resolve_path=True)` now resolves relative symlink targets against the link's directory (uses `os.path.realpath` alone), so `/tmp/demo/link -> real.txt` yields `/tmp/demo/real.txt` instead of `/real.txt`.
3. The help text now takes `default_map` into account: with `default_map={"foo": {"name": True}}`, `foo --help` shows `[default: name]`, matching the value the flag actually takes.
Full test suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed (unchanged from baseline).
